findings.description: The cup being poured contains only green olives (00:00-01:75), and the jar was empty at 00:00. A dark olive first appears on the jar floor at 00:00.5, vanishes at 00:01.0 (only three green olives present), reappears at 00:01.25, and by 00:01.75 the jar holds about six dark olives plus green ones. No dark olives exist in the cup or any bowl, so these olives materialize/change identity with no source.

Between 00:00 and 03:00 the jar goes from empty to ~25 olives poured from the small cup, yet the cup stays visibly full of green olives throughout the pour; its contents do not diminish in proportion to what lands in the jar.

findings.description: A small clear glass bottle stands on the counter right of the steel bowl from 00:04.50 onward; at 00:03.75 the same counter area is empty. Hands were busy with the cup and steel bowl and nothing placed it there.

The cup was refilled from the steel bowl, which contains only green olives (plus brown nut-like items). At 00:06.75-00:07.25 the cup holds several dark purple olives among the green ones, which could not have come from that bowl.

The second pour comes from a cup holding ~8-10 mostly green olives, yet the jar goes from ~25 olives (00:06.00) to roughly double, with dark olives now the majority. The amount and color mix added far exceed what the cup held.
